pages.title: Real Long-Count Cache
pages.text: Every Source Vein first stores resources in its own real cache. Automation, sneak extraction, and storage buses can only drain that cache; paid veins spend Immortal Yuan only for a cache shortfall. Turning a face off stops active export without hiding the standard capability.

Each face can export, bypass the limit, or stay off with its own per-tick rate. Fluid veins accept and void any fluid inserted through their faces. Inventory icons show the product at lower right. Water and Lava veins are also Create fan washing/blasting catalysts, and fan air passes through them.
The Echo Shard Source Vein unlocks at stage 8. It is non-stacking, converts one Echo Shard into 16 Immortal Yuan per batch, and participates in manager aggregation and per-face export.

A Source Vein Manager can only be placed inside its owner's Xianqiao. It has 72 single-item slots with at most one vein of each name. It exposes one aggregated extraction-only view while every member continues to work and save its own cache independently.

Twelve black beams form the manager's open cage. Eight rotating cores visualize the 72-slot occupancy in stages: blue when empty, purple while used, and red when full. Pickup preserves the displayed inventory/hand state, and legacy owner bindings migrate once to the shared persistent identity.
